states.CANDIDATE: An interpretation has been proposed but is not established.
states.CROSS_SOURCE_SUPPORTED: Relevant support spans independent source works; this requires explicit review.
states.ESTABLISHED: A strongly evidenced claim explicitly validated and approved; never assigned automatically.
states.OBSERVED: A source form or directly observable evidence exists.
states.REJECTED: A disproven interpretation retained with its evidence and review history.
states.SOURCE_SUPPORTED: Identifiable attested-source evidence directly supports the interpretation.
states.UNRESOLVED: Evidence or interpretation is insufficient or ambiguous.
states.VALIDATED: A claim passed a documented project validation protocol and human decision.
